caption:
Naming a stadium that doesn't exist.

Generali has put its name on the new home AC Milan and Inter plan to share: about 71,500 seats, construction expected from 2028, first match targeted for 2031/32.

It is also Official Insurance Partner of both clubs. A fee of about €650m has been reported, but the clubs and Generali haven't confirmed it and the reports disagree on the length.
